part2.title: Describe a time when you received some good news.
part2.closing: and explain why the news meant so much to you.
follow_up: Did you mark the occasion in any way?
Do you still remember the exact words that were used?
useful_language: it came out of the blue

items.prompt: Why do people want to share good news with others so quickly?
Is news given face to face more memorable than news sent by message?
Should newspapers and broadcasters report more positive stories?
